status_code_data.description: The HTTP 451 Unavailable For Legal Reasons client error response status code indicates that the user requested a resource that is not available due to legal reasons, such as a web page for which a legal action has been issued.

meme_data.description: Wait, That's Illegal refers to a reaction image taken from Red vs. Blue of a character saying the line. The meme became a popular reaction image used to humorously respond to situations that seem to violate rules or social norms.
